pieces.title: The concern, now a speck
pieces.caption: One avatar fills the frame. The view pulls back to its neighbours, then to all 329 pages at once, and the red square that marked it has not moved. *What is real and what is a choice:* Avatars in alphabetical order, so who sits beside whom means nothing. The page in the red square is Stoicism. *Leaking in:* Palace Map: 'the view from above is the Palace Map', so the pull-back ends on the palace.

verdicts.file: The View From Above — rich — the concern, now a speck.svg
verdicts.why: True to its numbers and out of the ordinary: the palace's own avatars, one metaphor, movement. Notes. It sits beside "Zoom out in space" in The Life Face, but what it shows is the next section's first bullet ("The view from above is the Map ... one lit node among hundreds"); the anchor would be truer there. The leak is on this page itself, not only on Palace Philosophies. The page's "honest version" is that the zoom resizes to true size, "which is not always smaller"; the piece only shrinks, and nothing owns that.
